title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Sexual Relations - Organizational Client
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A paralegal is representing a small corporation. Can the paralegal engage in a consensual sexual relationship with the corporation's CEO, who is instructing the paralegal on the file?
options: Yes, because the client is the corporation, not the CEO personally.
Yes, organizational officers are excluded from the rule against sexual relations with clients.
No, because the CEO is the individual who instructs the paralegal and represents the organization, this triggers the same conflict of interest and power imbalance concerns.
No, unless the CEO resigns from the corporation first.
questions.explain: Rule 3.06 on conflicts regarding sexual relations clarifies that when the client is an organization, engaging in a sexual relationship with an individual who directs the organization's legal matters or gives instructions on the file constitutes professional misconduct, as the power imbalance and loss of objectivity are still present.
